924 likes, 149 comments - technicalyogi on September 19, 2026: "Japan se wapas aane ke baad jo pyaar mila, usne dil chhoo liya. ❤️

Main Japan, Tokyo mein Google ke invite par Google Product Experts Asia-Pacific Annual Summit 2026 attend karne gaya tha, jahan mujhe India ko represent karne ka mauka mila. 🇮🇳

Aaj ghar wapas pahucha to colony ke logon ne dhol bajakar, mala pehnakar aur safa bandhkar mera swagat kiya.

Sach kahun to ye sirf mera samman nahi tha, ye un sabhi logon ka pyaar tha jo itne saalon se meri journey ka hissa rahe hain.

Dil se shukriya. ❤️🙏
Proud to represent India. 🇮🇳

#GoogleProductExperts #Japan #Tokyo #India #Grateful TechnicalYogi YogiYogendra".
